title: The night shift download
summary: An engineer who has just resigned to join a competitor badges into an empty office at 01:47. Build a timeline from badge, VPN, Git, USB and DLP records, and handle it the right way: evidence first, then HR and Legal.
ctf: The USB drive's volume label is a flag (step 6). Submit it on the CTF board as "The night shift download".

playbook.trigger: DLP alerts for confidential files copied to USB or uploaded to cloud storage
decisions: Preserve evidence before anyone talks to the employee
Involve HR and Legal before any action
targets: Preserve badge, VPN, Git, USB and DLP records the same day
Disable access when HR and Legal agree
notify: Customers, if their data left with the employee
done: Handover to HR and Legal with facts only
